data.narrative:
Terra Industries, a Series A defense & security company founded by Nathan Nwachuku and Maxwell Maduka, has raised $34M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 private and 2 public peers in the same sector and stage, including Stark Defence, Singularity, and NODA AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $34M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implying a $68M valuation. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $400M, with a wide range spanning $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence), reflecting material heterogeneity within the cohort.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $58M (low) to $460M (high), with a median point estimate of $234M. The substantial dispersion between methods—driven primarily by the peer range—indicates that stage-progression yields a floor estimate while peer multiples suggest meaningfully higher valuations depending on Terra's relative competitive positioning and growth trajectory. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the Stark Defence $4.0B anchor (a potential outlier) and Terra's differentiation within this heterogeneous peer set. Further diligence on unit economics and market traction would narrow the band.
